findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/checklist.ts:981-985 [critical] The preflight launch revalidation callback only compares headHash, materialHash, and storyFilesHash. It does not revalidate the CLI/worktree, Git index, writer identity or lease, provider capability, resource budget, or writable evidence target after preflight and immediately before child launch, so those states can change in the gap and the command can start despite an invalid preflight contract, violating CHK-004:adversarial:0 and allowing nonzero command execution or partial evidence writes.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 1626c43455: the launch-boundary callback now compares a canonical snapshot of all causal preflight facts, and checklist-causal-preflight-batch.test.mjs verifies the wiring and metrics response.

findings.desc: High: CertificationWindow accepts a stale causal advisory because CausalDependencyDecision has no current HEAD/materialHash/storyFilesHash binding. In packages/main/src/core/causal-evidence.ts:706-718 and 739-748, the decision carries only decision flags plus a self-hash; packages/main/src/core/certification-window.ts:703-715 verifies only that self-hash and gateAdmissible, then waives material drift whenever causalDecision=advisory and storyFilesHashAdvisory=true. Repro command: node --input-type=module -e with an advisory decision computed at currentMaterialHash=m2, then detectCertificationWindowMaterialDrift with live materialHash=m3 and the same storyFilesHash; observed {"decisionCurrentMaterial":"m2","liveMaterial":"m3","causalDecision":"advisory","decisionHashValid":true,"drift":{"drifted":false}}. A stale signed advisory can therefore keep specialized evidence admissible after a further material change; bind the decision to current material/HEAD/storyFilesHash and verify those bindings at consumption.

High: the acceptance contract is not currently admissible for B-5a15. acceptance_basis --storyId=B-5a15 --json reports status=invalid, basisStatus=partial, receiptVerification.ok=false with AT_SCOPE_BINDING_MISSING and freshness mismatch; acceptance_topology_check reports structuralPass=false, topologyState=legacy_missing, and AT_MISSING_TOPOLOGY; pre_review_check_read reports PR_ARTIFACT_MISSING; acceptance_rollout_report_read and acceptance_rollout_check both report AR_REPORT_MISSING with receipt=missing and quorum=degraded-or-missing. The review envelope requires a current signed PASS and genuine full 3 rounds x 2 hosts, so observe-mode blocking=false is only diagnostic and cannot serve as acceptance evidence. Regenerate and verify the canonical basis/topology/pre-review/rollout artifacts before claiming this story accepted.

.proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-5a15/pre-review-check.json:1-1098 and acceptance-basis.json:1-340 [high] Wave 4 verifier-owned acceptance coverage is not admissible. The current read-only checks show acceptance_topology_check structuralPass=false with AT_CLOSURE_FILES_STALE and AT_SCOPE_BINDING_MISSING; pre_review_check_read status=inconclusive, ok=false, executableEvidence=missing, PR_ARTIFACT_TAMPERED/PR_COVERAGE_INCONCLUSIVE and an executableProof with empty commandDigests, caseRecords, and bindingProofs; acceptance_rollout_report_read and acceptance_rollout_check both return AR_REPORT_MISSING with receipt=missing and quorum=degraded-or-missing. The checklist has 50 non-failing causal-evidence rows, but none is verifier-owned executable proof for acceptance_topology_check, pre_review_check_read, acceptance_rollout_report_read, or acceptance_rollout_check, so prompt/source prose in packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-pre-review-check-smoke.ts:144-152,927-1008 and packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-acceptance-rollout-smoke.ts:177-208,420-443 cannot establish current full 3 rounds x 2 hosts (codex-cli + claude-cli), degraded-3x1 rejection, threshold/membership/freshness mutations, mode-invariant diagnostics, enforce-only blocking, or non-destructive rollback-history coverage. Do not pass this lane until the verifier-owned artifacts and current executable receipts are regenerated and verified.

packages/main/src/core/causal-evidence.ts:496-497 reusable is derived only from identity completeness, so fail/timeout/cancelled/partial receipts written at lines 528-553 are cached and returned as reused instead of being re-executed; a transient failed pinned command permanently prevents a later PASS for the same key.

packages/main/src/core/causal-evidence.ts:688-695 verifyCausalPreflight accepts any ready report with an empty or failed checks map when its caller recomputes readinessHash; executeCausalEvidence then launches the child. This bypasses the required complete CLI/worktree/index/lease/capability/resource/target preflight.

packages/main/src/core/causal-evidence.ts:774-784 treats a missing previous or current materialHash as no material drift and returns fresh/gateAdmissible=true when dependency inputs match. Missing or uncomputable material identity must fall back to strict refusal, otherwise stale evidence can be reused when the hash probe failed.

packages/main/src/core/causal-evidence.ts:861-867 verifyCausalDependencyDecision checks only a caller-controlled content hash, not a signed producer or authority binding. Changing gateAdmissible=false to true and recomputing _hash verifies successfully, and CertificationWindow then accepts the forged stale decision.

packages/main/src/core/causal-evidence.ts:392-399 redacts output using key.identity.effectiveEnvironment after secret values were replaced by the same <redacted> placeholder; a command that prints a bare credential value is persisted verbatim in outputTail/outputProbe. The promised bounded redacted receipt therefore leaks raw secrets into the CAS artifact.

doc-promise-undelivered: packages/main/src/core/causal-evidence.ts:636-686 adds the expensive-run preflight, but packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:1417 still calls executeValidationPlan without it. proof-or-stop validate can therefore launch the expensive suite without the promised CLI/worktree/index/lease/capability/resource/evidence-target gate from CHK-004.
